formula: H_j=ReLU(sum_h,i,c grad(score,z_hic)*lambda_hij*v_hjc), j patch tokens; lambda=minmax cosine(q_hi,k_hj) over patch keys j per query/head
differences_from_official: all receiving queries, original 3 heads; channel gradient through downstream pooling/MLP; ReLU after query/head aggregation; epsilon clamp for constant QK rows; not validated as equivalent to paper
evaluation: original OpenVision cosine; 11 rounded patch counts spanning 0..196; zero after model normalization (ImageNet mean RGB); trapezoidal raw cosine AUC
selection: first 8 entries in downloaded Karpathy validation annotation order; first caption per entry; no result-based selection
finite_difference: scale last-block pre-output-projection attention context by 1+-0.001; compare central score difference to sum(grad_z*z)
